Sections.Name: General
Sections.Description: Enable Snowfall and choose automatic winter behavior or a tuning override.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Enable the local deformation surface and tracks. Packaged winter textures are static archive replacements.

Keys.Name: ActivationOverride
Keys.Description: Controls local deformation eligibility. Force On is for tuning; distance matching requires DFU to select a non-desert winter archive.

Sections.Name: Surface
Sections.Description: Advanced local fallback geometry. These controls do not change the fixed middle surface or distant blanket resolution.

Keys.Name: SnowRadius
Keys.Description: Radius in metres of the local snow window. Larger values push the exact mixed-tile handoff farther away but reduce grid density at the same mesh resolution.

Keys.Name: MeshResolution
Keys.Description: Grid vertices per side. Rebuilds the snow mesh.

Keys.Name: MaskResolution
Keys.Description: Local deformation-mask pixels per side. Rebuilds the disposable local view; persisted tracks remain recorded.

Keys.Name: RecenterDistance
Keys.Description: Distance between internal off-screen window recycling. World-anchored samples should prevent a visible refresh.

Keys.Name: MaxSnowSlope
Keys.Description: Snow depth tapers over the final 10 degrees and reaches a flat coating at this slope.

Sections.Name: Snowpack
Sections.Description: Game-time accumulation and melt of independent vanilla-location and wilderness snowpacks. Settlement keys apply to all supported vanilla locations, not just towns.

Keys.Name: SettlementMinimumDepth
Keys.Description: Vanilla-location starting and minimum depth in metres, including towns, farms, homes, dungeons, religious sites, taverns and graveyards.

Keys.Name: SettlementMaximumDepth
Keys.Description: Vanilla-location maximum depth in metres. If below the selected minimum, the minimum is used.

Keys.Name: WildernessMinimumDepth
Keys.Description: Wilderness starting and minimum depth in metres.

Keys.Name: WildernessMaximumDepth
Keys.Description: Wilderness maximum depth in metres. If below the selected minimum, the minimum is used.

Keys.Name: SnowfallDepthStep
Keys.Description: Metres added per completed continuous snowfall interval.

Keys.Name: SnowfallDepthHours
Keys.Description: Continuous game hours of snow per depth step.

Keys.Name: MeltDepthStep
Keys.Description: Metres lost per completed continuous clear-weather interval.

Keys.Name: MeltDepthHours
Keys.Description: Continuous game hours without snow per melt step.

Keys.Name: DebugSnowDepthOverride
Keys.Description: Diagnostic: zero uses the snowpack; a positive value forces one depth across the physical snow surface.

Sections.Name: Context
Sections.Description: Spatial snow-depth limits at vanilla exterior locations and optional Location Loader locations.

Keys.Name: SettlementBoundaryFeather
Keys.Description: Metres of depth transition outside supported vanilla-location rectangles. Player ships are excluded.

Keys.Name: LocationLoaderIntegration
Keys.Description: Cap snow over authored Location Loader locations while leaving decorations at wilderness depth. Has no effect if Location Loader is absent.

Keys.Name: LocationLoaderMaximumDepth
Keys.Description: Maximum snow depth in metres within an authored Location Loader footprint.

Keys.Name: LocationLoaderBoundaryFeather
Keys.Description: Metres of cap transition outside an authored Location Loader footprint.

Sections.Name: Basic Roads
Sections.Description: Optional Basic Roads 1.3.1 normal-tile integration. Splatmapping and editing modes are unsupported.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Apply shallow path snow and road shoulders when the supported dependency is ready.

Keys.Name: PathMaximumDepth
Keys.Description: Absolute path snow cap in metres. Does not increase snow above the surrounding snowpack depth.

Keys.Name: PathFeather
Keys.Description: Outward path-depth transition in metres.

Keys.Name: BermsEnabled
Keys.Description: Modest static snow shoulders beside classified main roads, below all context caps.

Keys.Name: BermRise
Keys.Description: Maximum extra shoulder height in metres, bounded by the local snowpack maximum.

Keys.Name: BermWidth
Keys.Description: Snow-side shoulder width in metres; does not change road exclusion.

Sections.Name: Visual
Sections.Description: Snow texture scale and track appearance. Path snow also has a fixed, subtle 3% tint.

Keys.Name: TextureWorldSize
Keys.Description: World-space repeat size in metres for the snow tile.

Keys.Name: CompressionDarkening
Keys.Description: How strongly compressed snow darkens.

Keys.Name: ImpressionStrength
Keys.Description: Focuses compression into a narrower, deeper track centre. Zero is the linear stored profile; one is the full focused profile.

Keys.Name: ImpressionShoulderWidth
Keys.Description: Adds this many metres of gradual slope to each side of new player and NPC tracks. The nominal TrackWidth remains the compressed core.

Sections.Name: Distance Prototype
Sections.Description: Raised middle and distant snow coverage. The middle surface deforms; outer terrain shows tracks through shading only. Section name is retained for saved-setting compatibility.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Enable both the middle physical surface and loaded-terrain blanket. Turning this off retains local deformation and packaged winter textures. Startup and travel still depend on terrain streaming.

Keys.Name: DistantTracks
Keys.Description: Show persisted tracks as low-cost darkened marks on the distance blanket out to 320 metres. The distant mesh is not displaced.

Keys.Name: TrackWidth
Keys.Description: Compressed core width in metres. ImpressionShoulderWidth adds a sloped shoulder on each side.

Keys.Name: RemainingSnow
Keys.Description: Fraction of snow depth left at the trench centre.

Keys.Name: StampSpacing
Keys.Description: Movement in metres required before another segment is stamped.

Sections.Name: NPC Tracks
Sections.Description: Tracks made by grounded enemies and wandering town civilians.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Allow grounded enemies and civilians to leave new tracks. Off preserves existing tracks and does not disable corpse impressions.

Keys.Name: TrackWidth
Keys.Description: Minimum width in metres of an NPC track.

Keys.Name: RemainingSnow
Keys.Description: Fraction of snow depth left at the NPC track centre.

Keys.Name: StampSpacing
Keys.Description: NPC movement in metres required before another segment is stamped.

Sections.Name: Refill
Sections.Description: Game-time recovery of recent actor deformation.

Keys.Name: PassiveRefillHours
Keys.Description: Approximate game hours for fully compressed snow to refill; zero refills immediately.

Keys.Name: SnowfallRefillHours
Keys.Description: Approximate game hours for fully compressed snow to refill during active snowfall.
